brief: Out of 1,307 screened parcels, we identified 273 actionable sites with 220 immediate offer candidates penciling at current land comps. This week we are prioritizing four top-scoring opportunities across private acquisitions, a faith-owned joint venture, and a major city-owned RFP site. These targets capitalize on 485-x tax incentives and City of Yes density boosts to deliver double-digit cash-on-cash potential.

targets.play: Acquire this private Williamsburg lot for a 7-unit build under 485-x Option C with 50 percent market and 50 percent stabilized rents.
targets.negotiation: Max offer is capped at $1,047,948 against an estimated land cost of $952,680, providing $95,268 in headroom.
targets.risk: Verify current site condition and physical access before sending the offer letter.

targets.play: Execute a private acquisition to construct 9 units using 485-x Option C small building tax exemptions.
targets.negotiation: Max offer is capped at $1,314,558 against an estimated land cost of $1,195,053, providing $119,505 in headroom.
targets.risk: Verify lot occupancy status to confirm the parcel is completely vacant.

targets.play: Structure a ground-lease JV with the faith-owned institution as a 51 percent qualified partner for the HPD Neighborhood Builders Fast Track pipeline.
targets.negotiation: Negotiate ground lease terms anchored to the $353,574 estimated land cost with a maximum offer baseline of $388,931 and significant headroom up to the $2,312,658 walk-away land value.
targets.risk: Verify institutional-owner approval and internal congregational governance required to execute a lease.

targets.play: Position our shop for a 67-unit disposition using City of Yes UAP for a 20 percent FAR bump and 485-x exemption.
targets.negotiation: Do not submit a private offer; contact the local Council member and community board to monitor the city RFP pipeline.
targets.risk: Verify local sewer capacity and street infrastructure for a development of this scale.
